data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for easy Android APK installation.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin designed for easy Android APK installation. It is compatible with Android API 19 and higher.
use_when: You need to install Android APK files programmatically from within your Flutter app.
You are targeting Android API 19 or higher.
avoid_when: You are building for iOS or other non-Android platforms.
You need advanced app store management features.
strengths: Compatible with Android API 19 and higher
